1.explanation: We create a HTTP server that never serves any paintable content inside <body>, so Chrome will never fire First-Contentful-Paint.  Lighthouse’s defaultPass now waits for FCP (up to 35 s), then tracing.end will hang until the 60 s protocol timeout.  To make the test finish faster we override the FCP and load timeouts to 10 s each.  When you run this reproducer you will see Lighthouse throw a PROTOCOL_TIMEOUT (or NO_FCP) error after the configured timeout, exactly reproducing the 60 s hang in loadPage-defaultPass.
1.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse spins up Chrome and runs the “defaultPass” it now will wait for the First-Contentful-Paint (FCP) event before it stops tracing.  If a page never fires FCP (or fires it after the 35 sec maxWaitForLoad), Lighthouse will continue tracing until it finally hits the 60 sec driver.sendCommand(Tracing.end) timeout and error out.  In our production heatmaps you can see that after merging pull request #6944 the 95th percentile for “loadPage-defaultPass” jumps up to ~40 sec and then eventually timeouts at 60 sec when no FCP is ever observed.
